popover.$description: Popover: content next to the element it belongs to, with a title, a close button and an arrow where the language draws one.

offset.$description: The gap between the popover and its target.

enter-offset.$description: How far it comes in from its target as it appears (0: it only fades in).

header-gap.$description: Between the title and the close button.

close.$description: The close button in the header.

surface.$description: The popover: its fill, frame, corners and shadow; `focus` when the keys put focus on the surface itself.

arrow.$description: The arrow towards the target: a square turned on its corner, the half outside showing (`display` shows it; `size` its side; its fill and frame continue the surface's).

header.$description: The row with the title and the close button.
